name: Sakuhito
source:
[i]"Me, a good person? There is much more about me you do not know."[/i]

Sakuhito is usually a cheerful and amiable person, but when he acts as the Emperor's wirepuller, he is cold and dignified. He was born in one of the Eastern Provinces and was dragged to the capital to work for the Emperor at the age of 14, and although you'd expect him to bear a grudge, he's extremely fond of the Emperor.

Perhaps there is some reason the Emperor chose him to be his right-hand man.

[[url=https://shall-we-date.fandom.com/wiki/Sakuhito]From Hinata's notes[/url]]
